title: The Silly mistake in the letter
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：silly　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 silly 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the athlete wrote of ① a silly mistake in the letter in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② more silly than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the silly ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most silly mistake in the letter anybody in the stadium had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too silly to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the silly ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a silly grin of the boy, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as silly as the grin of the boy they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was silly or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something silly, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite silly; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the silly ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, year after year, she wrote of another silly mistake in the letter in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more silly than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most silly grin of the boy in the whole stadium, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the silly ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 愚蠢（前置定语 a silly mistake in the letter：1965 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件愚蠢的错误）
B. adj. 愚蠢／傻气（比较级 more silly than：文中两处，一处比信里愚蠢的错误，一处比预想）
C. adj. 愚蠢／傻气（最高级 the most silly：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 愚蠢（表语 too silly to do：母亲觉得它太愚蠢，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 傻气（前置定语 a silly grin of the boy：叔叔把整件事称作一桩傻气的笑）
F. adj. 傻气（同级比较 as silly as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩男孩傻气的笑相比）
G. adj. 傻气（后置定语 something silly：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 傻气（受程度副词修饰 quite silly：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a silly mistake in the letter
the most silly mistake in the letter anybody
a silly grin of the boy
The most silly grin of the boy in

answers.why: silly 意为“愚蠢”，1965 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件愚蠢的错误”，此处作前置定语 a silly mistake in the letter。
silly 意为“愚蠢”，此处用比较级 more silly than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
silly 意为“愚蠢”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说它是体育场里最愚蠢的一件，故用最高级 the most silly mistake in the letter。
silly 意为“愚蠢”，母亲认为这件东西“太愚蠢了，谁也用不上”，too silly to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
silly 意为“傻气”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩傻气的笑”，此处作前置定语 a silly grin of the boy。
silly 意为“傻气”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩男孩傻气的笑一样傻气”，同级比较用 as silly as。
silly 意为“傻气”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“傻气的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something silly。
silly 意为“傻气”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当傻气”，quite 修饰原级 silly。
silly 意为“傻气”，1975 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要傻气”，故用比较级 more silly than。
silly 意为“傻气”，母亲 1977 年说的是“整个体育场里最傻气的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most silly grin of the boy。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件愚蠢的错误。（a silly mistake in the letter）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更愚蠢。（more silly than …）
母亲觉得它太愚蠢，谁也用不上。（too silly to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩傻气的笑。（a silly grin of the boy）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩男孩傻气的笑一样傻气。（as silly as …）
到了 1972 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件傻气的东西。（something silly）
answers: In 1965 the athlete wrote of a silly mistake in the letter in the programme.
Everybody said it was more silly than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too silly to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a silly grin of the boy.
He said nobody would call it as silly as the grin of the boy they had once had.
By 1972 the programme asked for nothing but something silly.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 silly 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the athlete wrote of a silly mistake in the letter in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most silly mistake in the letter in the stadium, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too silly to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a silly grin of the boy, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite silly, and everybody laughed.
The silly ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
